user.title: Connect to Silines
user.description: Enter the network parameters and authentication data of your Silines controller.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Silines Network Settings
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details or credentials for this Silines controller if the IP address or credentials have changed.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the controller. Check IP address and port.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication error. Invalid username or password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Please check the system log.
error.timeout_greater_than_interval: API Timeout cannot be greater than or equal to Polling Interval!

abort.already_configured: This Silines device is already configured in the system.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this Silines controller is already in progress.

pulse_relay.name: Trigger relay pulse
pulse_relay.description: Sends a short-timed pulse command to the targeted Silines relay switch entity.

duration_ms.name: Duration (ms)
duration_ms.description: The duration in milliseconds for the relay to remain active. If omitted, the device default hardware pulse configuration will be triggered.
